verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official, Apache-licensed CLI. It is documented for terminal and automated use, installed with `npm i -g vercel`, and authenticated with access tokens. It also has agent-specific subcommands: `vercel agent init` writes AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance and `vercel skills` discovers skills. Vercel's agent playbook tells coding agents to install and use the CLI themselves. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI working well in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system
